remainingFindings.issue: D06 create/start/cancel/take/retire status functions are not distinguished from nonfallible void cleanup. A void start cannot establish accepted-versus-rejected responsibility as required by the explicit profile.
remainingFindings.required: The known D06 profile requires u32 status on nonrelease steps; release remains the exact no-fail owner cleanup.

remainingFindings.contract: Design docs/contracts/callback-v0.1.md section3 and async-v0.1.md sections3and8
remainingFindings.issue: Notification profile permits owned outputs and payload lifetime beyond the callback despite the pinned borrowed-notification/typed-take rule.
remainingFindings.required: D05 notification payloads stay within callback lifetime; owned result transfer occurs through the declared later typed-take path.

scopeNote: These are validation of explicitly selected D05/D06 profiles, not implementation of A07/A08 runtime machinery or new generator features.
